parameters.content:
## Vera 05 · 06 NOC report draft
When the walk ends: code scores the checklist and decides the recommendation; AI only words the engineer's remarks in English; the wording is checked; a PDF goes to the engineer to sign with one tap.

Generated from `n8n/mobilise/workflows.mjs`. Edit there and rebuild; edits made here are overwritten on the next import.
Each node's note says what it does and which guardrails it carries.

nodes.name: Every night 9 PM (safety net)
nodes.notes: Catches a walk the engineer forgot to finish.

parameters.query:
select w.mobilisation_id from walks w join mobilisations mo on mo.id = w.mobilisation_id
where mo.visit_date = current_date and not exists (select 1 from noc_reports r where r.mobilisation_id = w.mobilisation_id);

nodes.name: Load the visit

parameters.query:
select mo.id as mobilisation_id, row_to_json(mo) as mob, mo.visit_date::text as visit_date,
  (select json_agg(json_build_object('code', l.code, 'area', l.area, 'text', l.text, 'severity', l.severity, 'when', l."when", 'status', l.status, 'reason', l.reason, 'remark', l.remark,
      'photos', (select count(*) from evidence e where e.mobilisation_id = mo.id and e.line_code = l.code)) order by l.code) from lines l where l.mobilisation_id = mo.id) as lines,
  (select json_agg(json_build_object('line', e.line_code, 'text', e.transcript, 'lang', e.transcript_lang)) from evidence e where e.mobilisation_id = mo.id and e.transcript is not null) as remarks,
  (select json_agg(json_build_object('lat', t.lat, 'lng', t.lng, 'accuracy', t.accuracy, 'ts', t.ts)) from trail t join walks w on w.id = t.walk_id where w.mobilisation_id = mo.id) as trail,
  (select json_agg(json_build_object('gps', e.gps)) from evidence e where e.mobilisation_id = mo.id and e.gps is not null) as captures,
  (select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('area', z.area, 'name', z.name) || z.shape) from zones z where z.mobilisation_id = mo.id) as zones,
  (select json_agg(distinct l.area) from lines l where l.mobilisation_id = mo.id and l."when" = 'walk') as walk_areas,
  (select id from contacts where mobilisation_id = mo.id and role = 'engineer' limit 1) as contact_id,
  (select coalesce(max(version), 0) + 1 from noc_reports where mobilisation_id = mo.id) as version
from mobilisations mo where mo.id = $1;

nodes.notes:
Every line, photo count, transcript, GPS fix and area.
Guardrails: retry

nodes.name: Which areas were walked
nodes.notes: An area counts as walked only with GPS fixes inside it (allowing for each fix's own error).

nodes.name: Score the visit
nodes.notes:
Recommendation by rule: any critical open or an area not walked → not ready; majors open → ready with conditions.
Guardrails: audit

nodes.name: Build wording request
nodes.notes: Remarks + open items, already decided. AI is told not to decide anything.

nodes.name: Claude: word the observations
nodes.notes:
Hindi / Marathi remarks → plain English observations, citing line codes.
Guardrails: retry, error-out, timeout

nodes.name: Check the wording
nodes.notes:
Only known line codes, no verdict words. If it fails, the engineer's own transcripts go in instead.
Guardrails: schema

nodes.name: Build report page
nodes.notes: Recommendation, open items with due dates, areas walked, observations. Says which parts AI wrote.

nodes.name: HTML to PDF (Gotenberg)
nodes.notes:
Self-hosted, next to n8n. No report leaves our servers to be printed.
Guardrails: retry, error-out

nodes.name: Store report PDF
nodes.notes:
Versioned: a re-draft never overwrites a signed report.
Guardrails: retry, audit

parameters.query:
insert into noc_reports (mobilisation_id, version, score, narrative, narrative_ok, s3_key)
values ($1, $2, $3::jsonb, $4::jsonb, $5, $6) on conflict (mobilisation_id, version) do nothing returning id as noc_id, mobilisation_id;

options.queryReplacement: ={{ [($('Load the visit').item.json.mobilisation_id) ?? null, ($('Load the visit').item.json.version) ?? null, (JSON.stringify($('Check the wording').item.json.score)) ?? null, (JSON.stringify($('Check the wording').item.json.narrative)) ?? null, ($('Check the wording').item.json.narrative_ok) ?? null, ('mob/' + $('Load the visit').item.json.mobilisation_id + '/noc-v' + $('Load the visit').item.json.version + '.pdf') ?? null] }}

nodes.name: Create open items

options.queryReplacement: ={{ [($('Save NOC draft').item.json.mobilisation_id) ?? null, (JSON.stringify($('Check the wording').item.json.score.open_items)) ?? null] }}

nodes.notes: Each open line becomes a dated item for WF-07.

nodes.name: Build sign-off message
nodes.notes: PDF + Approve / With conditions / Hold buttons.

nodes.name: Send to engineer to sign
nodes.notes:
The button reply from his own number is the sign-off, kept with its WhatsApp id. The NOC is never issued without it.
Guardrails: human, audit

nodes.name: Alert: report failed

parameters.query: insert into review_queue (mobilisation_id, reason) values ($1, 'NOC PDF could not be made: ' || $2) returning id;

nodes.notes:
Vera ops sends it by hand; the engineer is not left waiting.
Guardrails: human
